Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game. A surprising start to the tournament to be fair and we hope it continues the same way. Don't go far away as game two of group A is about to start. UAE will take on Netherlands. So, switch the tabs and join us there. It's goodbye from here!

Gerhard Erasmus says last year was a special journey and it is a special day for them. Tells they have brought a winning culture into the team with the limited resources they have and also with the wonderful coaching staff they have. On the Head Coach, Pierre de Bruyne, he has turned the whole ship around. Ends by saying this is a payback for his effort.

Dasun Shanaka says they didn't execute well with the ball which is a bit of concern. Adds they need to build some partnerships and the openers need to give a good start. Reckons they need to trust the process and not do anything special.

Jan Frylinck is the Player of the Match. He says he is speechless at the moment after what they achieved and he is very excited right now. Adds JJ Smit took the pressure of him and eventually they reached a competitive total. Appreciates the bowler's performance. Informs the pitch was two-paced.
...Presentation coming up...

Gerhard Erasmus during the toss told that this pitch will aid his bowlers! It turned out to be very true. David Wiese struck in the second over but it was Ben Shikongo who struck twice in two wickets to put Sri Lanka on the back foot completely. Namibia did well to take wickets at regular intervals. Once, they got the opposition skipper, Namibia started believing that an upset is on the cards. A special mention to Namibia's fielding, it was absolutely brilliant as they took some outstanding catches. Earlier, it was crucial for Namibia to get a good finish and the cameos from Jan Frylinck and JJ Smit turned out to be a match-winning one. The Lankan bowlers gave away 68 runs in the last five overs and lost the match there.

Sri Lanka were disappointing with the bat. They didn't start well and kept losing wickets at regular intervals. The hopes were still alive when Dasun Shanaka and Bhanuka Rajapaksa were in the middle but the wicket of the latter started a big collapse. Dasun Shanaka's wicket completely shattered the dreams and Sri Lanka who were firm favorites to win this game and win the group have to recheck the status. What a start to the ICC T20I World Cup 2022.

Well played Namibia! Really well played! They have defeated the Asia Cup champions comprehensively. To be honest, no one saw this coming but that is the beauty of the big tournaments. A statement win by Namibia here.

OUT! TAKEN! There it is! Namibia win! This is full and outside off. Dushmantha Chameera swings across but without conviction and Gerhard Erasmus at deep mid-wicket takes the catch. NAMIBIA WIN BY 55 RUNS.
Commentary.Howout: c Gerhard Erasmus b David Wiese

On middle, kept out.

OUT! CAUGHT! A length ball, around off. Chamika Karunaratne steps down and across to heave but just like other batsmen, he mistimes and it goes to long off where Stephan Baard completes the wicket. Namibia are one wicket away from the victory.
Commentary.Howout: c Stephan Baard b JJ Smit

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on middle. Chameera hoicks across but mistimes and the ball lobs to square leg where it falls in front of the running fielder. A single.
Fuller ball on off. Dushmantha Chameera clips it to mid-wicket for a single. Five overs to go now. Sri Lanka need 73 runs with 2 wickets in hand.
Tossed up, tailing in on off. Dushmantha Chameera defends.
Angling on the pads, flicked to square leg for one.
Full and outside off. Chameera works it to cover for a single.

OUT! RUN OUT! The last thing Sri Lanka wanted! Tossed up, outside off. Karunaratne tries to tap and run. Pramod Madushan was a bit late to respond to the call. He runs across and puts a dive but till then Michael Van Lingen picks the ball at point and underarms to the keeper who clips the bails off. Sri Lanka 8 down now.
Commentary.Howout: run out (Michael Van Lingen / Zane Green)

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and outside off. Karunaratne punches it back to the bowler.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Green takes an excellent catch! Namibia have been very good on the field and they now have the big wicket of the skipper. Namibia smell a victory now! This is full and outside off. Dasun Shanaka has a big swing across the line. He gets a top edge and flies high in the air. It was swirling in the air and the keeper, Zane Green calls for it. In the end, he dives forward and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Zane Green b Jan Frylinck

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball on middle. Shanaka heaves it to deep mid-wicket. Ben Shikongo runs across from long on and makes a superb stop to save a couple of runs.
Outside off. Karunaratne steps across and taps it to point for one.
Length and outside off. Shanaka drops it to cover for a single.
This is full and on the pads. Shanaka misses his flick and gets his on the pads.
This is full and on middle. Karunaratne nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on middle. Karunaratne tickles it to square leg for a single.
On middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, knocked to covers for a single.

OUT! What a catch by Nicol Loftie-Eaton! Dasun Shanaka sees another wicket fall over and he waits for someone to help him! Tosses it up, full and on off. Wanindu Hasaranga looks to slog-sweep but toe ends his shot to deep mid-wicket. Nicol Loftie-Eaton has a lot of ground to cover, he runs across to his left and takes a diving catch.

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up, outside off. Dasun skips down and pushes it to long off for a single.
Around off, punched to cover.

Wanindu Hasaranga makes room again, this is over middle. Wanindu Hasaranga swings and misses.
This is full and on off. Wanindu Hasaranga makes room and lofts it to deep cover. The ball falls in front of the ropes and stops. Two runs are taken.
Length and outside off. Shanaka plays it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and on middle. Defended out.
A full ball, in line of off. Wanindu Hasaranga works it to third man for a single.
Three runs and a big wicket of Bhanuka Rajapaksa of the over. Shorter and on off. Wanindu Hasaranga slaps it through point for one.
On middle, kept out.
Flatter and on off, Wanindu Hasaranga punches it to cover.

OUT! TAKEN! A stand was building and Namibia quickly break the partnership! Bernard Scholtz strikes now! Tossed up, around off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa comes down the track but fails to reach to the pitch of the ball. He tries to go over long on but ends up hitting it straight in the hands of Divan la Cock.

Commentary.Commentary: A single as this is hit to long on.
Tossed up on middle, tucked to square leg for a single.

Drinks. Sri Lanka are getting back on track now. A good couple of overs for them but still a lot of work to do. The skipper is looking in good touch and will hope to play a big innings now. They still need 92 runs from the last 10 overs. Namibia need wickets to stay in the game.
A single to end the over as this is hit to mid-wicket.
Short in length and on middle. Dasun pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Two in a row! Shanaka changing gears now. Short again. Shanaka pulls and it goes over short fine leg for four.
FOUR! Well played! Too much width, outside off. Shanaka latches on it as he slashes it away past point for a boundary.
On middle. Rajapaksa looks to pull. He slices it in the air and wide of mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and outside off. Shanaka works it to deep backward point for one.
Around off. Shanaka plays with soft hands and drops it on the deck on the off side. He waits for Rajapaksa's call and then runs across. A sharp single.
SIX! BANG! Short and outside off, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a biggie.

Make it three now! This is full and on the pads. The ball rolls on the deck back to the bowler. Shanaka wasn't aware and runs across but sees in the last moment and gets back to his crease. He bumps with Jan Frylinck in the process.
Outside off. Dasun defends it to cover. Two dots now.
This is full and on off. Shanaka looks to push but gets an inside edge onto the pads.  It rolls away towards point.
Full and on off. Rajapaksa knocks it to cover for one.
A single as this is pulled to deep square leg.
FOUR! A welcome boundary and a much needed one! Ben serves it on a length and outside off, angling away. Rajapaksa looks to drive but gets an outside edge to the third man fence.
Touch short and on middle. Shanaka pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Around off, knocked to point for a single.
On a length and on top of off. Shanaka is squared up as he looks to defend. A single as it rolls to point.
Short in length and outside off. Shanaka slaps it through point for a couple.
On middle, defended out.
A slower length ball, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa has a poke but misses.
Wide! Jan tries the slower ball but this is down the leg side. Bhanuka Rajapaksa misses the pull shot.
This is full and on off, pushed through covers for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one goes for Sri Lanka! De Silva goes now! This is full and on middle. De Silva tries to whack it away but fails to get the distance. Ben Shikongo takes the catch behind square on the leg side.
Commentary.Howout: c Ben Shikongo b Jan Frylinck

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on off, drilled to long on for a single.
JUST WIDE! Short and outside off. De Silva dabs it on the up and just over the fielder at point for a single.
Around off, eased to mid on for a single. What a Powerplay for Namibia. Sri Lanka are reeling on 38/3. They need 126 more runs to win in 84 balls.
Slower one on the pads. Bhanuka Rajapaksa helps it to fine leg for a single. It is given as a leg bye.
Another quick single as this is hit through point.
A QUICK SINGLE! Length and on middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa taps it in front of point for a single.
On a length and on middle. Bhanuka Rajapaksa blocks on the leg side.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Too full and outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa smashes it through covers for a boundary.
Length and outside off. De Silva tries to play with soft hands but gets an outside edge and the ball bounces in front of the keeper.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, guided to third man for a brace.
THREE RUNS! Length ball, outside ofof. De Silva skips down and punches it past the diving mid off fielder.
Length and outside off, this one skids on. Dhananjaya de Silva looks to cut but misses.
Length and around off. Rajapaksa drops it to cover for a single.
Wide! This is just sliding down. Rajapaksa misses his flick.
Leg bye! On the pads, tickled to square leg for a leg bye. It came off the pads! What an over! Sri Lanka under pressure and they need to calm things down now.

A HUGE APPEAL FOR LBW! The umpire shakes his head! Every single player of Namibia appeal! That looked like pitching outside leg. Of course, Namibia will take the review. The replay confirms it is outside the line. Not out it is! Ohh, what an eventful over this is turning out to be! This is full and on leg. Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets forward as he looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. That was just down the leg side.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Another one bites the dust! Sri Lanka under pressure now! This is excellent from Namibia! Ben Shikongo steams in and serves it on a length and outside off, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to defend but gets an outside edge and it goes straight in Zane Green's mitts. A dream start for Ben Shikongo and he is on a Hat-trick.
